gate_decisions.reason: The six declared Task requirements are satisfied within their finite and typed scope. Further efficient compiler, general EM exponential-bound and native embedding questions exceed this Task; no automatic successor is justified.

Known-source statement/interface matching and conservative reuse are explicit: classical four-relation closure, summary_join and h/h^2 baselines are not new tools or new lower bounds. No exhaustive novelty search or universal absence-of-prior-art claim is made.

The existing independent direct-trace/cycle and Floyd-Warshall audit validates all 19 fixed graphs/216 entry rows/114 witnesses. The execution delta was independently joined to full raw logs, configurations, authority and Source; no gratuitous second comparator run is needed for this scoped acceptance.

The immutable return preserves reusable flagged first-exit interface, composition proof, path/cut certificate, exact counted mask-fold and explicit RAM-projection obstruction. They remain task evidence with declared costs and known classical reuse; no new canonical toolbox family or production integration is asserted.

Seven targeted corruptions were independently rejected; empty segment/marked empty input, zero/positive steps, accepting continuation, closed cuts, same-forward-support contexts and inactive-leaf merging were explicitly challenged. New execution logs/configurations and missing historical tool-override snapshot were independently inspected and honestly bounded.
